page.overview:
What is Ptmâk?

Ptmâk is reported in an antehuman text to be the "immediate" parent of Cthulhu (Kthulhut) and his race (the Cosmic Octopi). It appears to have remained dwelling of Vhoorl and is thus quite obscure. Ptmâk has some connection to Nug, and may be another name for Nug.

Ptmâk was created by Clark Ashton Smith in letters to R. H. Barlow. Lin Carter attempted to incorporate some of the information into his work.

The letter is written ambiguously about who is a child of Nug: "The immediate parent of Cthulhu and his race (child of Nug) was Ptmâk". Comparing Smith's letter with his and Lovecraft's Family trees of Azathoth suggests that Ptmâk and Cxaxukluth are the Hyperborean versions of Nug and Yeb.

[http://www.eldritchdark.com/writings/correspondence/59 Smith's letter to Barlow]
